subject: MATHEMATICS
principles: Execution order may vary; authority order may not.
A first-role decision must be grounded in original evidence rather than stage convention.
Absence of question evidence is not evidence of low importance.
A hard owner override changes the operational route but never rewrites the system finding or ground truth.
A soft override may choose only an evidence-admissible role.

score_rubric.0: Absent or no usable evidence for this dimension.
score_rubric.1: Fragmentary evidence; insufficient to establish the dimension.
score_rubric.2: Partial or coarse evidence; useful but not independently decisive.
score_rubric.3: Strong evidence that materially establishes the dimension.
score_rubric.4: Direct, authoritative or highly resolved evidence for the dimension.

decision_order.when: conflict_index >= 3 OR referenced ground-truth evidence is CONFLICTED

decision_order.note: If both roles are eligible, semantic authority starts the normal route; Core2 still independently re-grounds later.

decision_order.when: neither role is eligible but at least partial evidence exists

override_policy.HARD: May replace the system action with CORE1_FIRST, CORE2_FIRST or BLOCK_OWNER_REVIEW. System action remains recorded.
override_policy.SOFT: May replace the system action only with a role already present in eligible_roles. Otherwise it is ignored.
